zh: 总分由两部分组成：每个有令牌（T）的格子贡献自己的分值，每一对相邻且都有令牌的格子额外贡献 1 分。两部分可以分开算。
基础分直接累加所有 T 格子的分值；奖励分要数“相邻的 T-T 对”，连续 k 个 T 会贡献 k−1 对，不是整段只加一次。
逐个扫描格子：若第 i 格是 T，把 points[i] 加入总分，并且若 i > 0 且第 i−1 格也是 T，再加 1；扫描结束输出总分。
en: The score has two parts: every cell with a token (T) contributes its own value, and every pair of adjacent cells that both hold tokens adds 1 more. The two parts can be computed separately.
The base part sums the values of all T cells; the bonus counts adjacent T-T pairs, and a run of k consecutive Ts contributes k-1 pairs, not just one bonus for the whole run.
Scan the cells: if cell i is T, add points[i] to the score, and if i > 0 and cell i-1 is also T, add 1; print the score after the scan.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First add up the values of all T cells, then check every pair of adjacent cells for whether both are T. A run of k consecutive Ts contributes k−1 adjacent pairs, not just a single bonus.

## Why it is correct

Each base point corresponds to exactly one T cell, and each bonus point corresponds to exactly one T-T adjacent edge. The loop checks every cell and every adjacent edge exactly once, so nothing is counted twice or missed.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) extra space apart from the input.
